title: Business Breakdowns - Trailer
summary: In each episode, we will dissect a new company with investors and operators that know it best. We believe every business has secrets and lessons to learn from, and these conversations are designed to deliver that content in an entertaining and narrative format. The series launches today with Shopify, so check out the links below and give it a listen.
